document.about: ILO World Employment and Social Outlook: Trends 2025. Page 22's Figure 1.1 is a table of figures under stacked column heads. The first column's head, `World`, is set across the table's left edge: `Wor` outside it, `ld` inside.

notes: The heads are read out of the table as its title. `World` has its centre of mass outside the table, so the page's prose reads it whole.

checks.issue: The title read each glyph by its own centre: `World`'s `l` and `d`, centred inside the table, were read into the title as well as into `World` in the prose (`… income ld countries …`).
Guard: the prose keeps the word whole.
